show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: WTT - I Don't Know
summary:
The late Peter Bernstein defined risk as, you don't know what will happen, adding, even when you think you do. At the end of my last blog, playing for tomorrow, I shared a series of opportunities
and risks that I believe have a greater than 50% chance of occurring. For example,
stocks need to earn a risk premium over bonds over a long period of time for capitalism to function.

reader_summary.overview: On today's version of my blog post, What Ted's Thinking, I share a bunch of things on my mind that fall under the title. I ask every guest on the podcast, what's your biggest investment pet peeve? Mine is investors who express absolutes in a world of probabilities.
